description: Défense Extérieure Contre l’Incendie (DECI) : Débit minimum garanti à 1bar des Point d'Eau Incendie publics sous pression (PEI) is a dataset listed in Plateforme Open Data Ville et Eurométropole de Strasbourg, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville et eurométropole de Strasbourg. Le service de l’Eau et de l’Assainissement de l’Eurométropole de Strasbourg, met à disposition en accès libre les informations concernant les Points d’Eau Incendie. Vous y trouverez les informations concernant les numéros des appareils (EMS et SIS67), ainsi que les débits garantis et la pression statique du réseau. Coverage: Strasbourg Eurométropole. The portal files it under Environnement, Sécurité civile. Its keywords are pei, poteau incendie, Strasbourg, deci. The portal shows 5,966 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-strasbourg-eu-portal.
